Metadata.title: CosOverHere - Põhjamaad & Baltikum
Metadata.description: Leia kõik lähedal toimuvad animeüritused ning kohvikud, kaubanduskeskused ja pildistamiskohad, kus cosplay'jad on oodatud - Helsingis, Vantaas ja Espoos.

Nav.notice: CosOverHere on ühe inimese projekt. Sõbrad aitavad aeg-ajalt kaasa.

Home.title: Animeüritused + <grad>cosplay-kohad</grad> Põhjamaades ja Baltikumis
Home.lead: Leia kõik lähedal toimuvad conid - ning kohvikud, kaubanduskeskused ja pildistamiskohad, kus cosplay'jad on oodatud. Pildid ja teemad näitavad kohe, kus pildistada.
Home.upcomingDesc: Vaata üle ja planeeri oma järgmised cosplayd. Kõik üritused on loetletud koos kuupäevade, toimumiskohtade ja linkidega ametlikele lehtedele. Mõnda üritust ei reklaamita laialt, nii et sirvi nimekirja ja leia peidetud pärleid.
Home.hotSpotsDesc: Kohvikud, kaubanduskeskused ja pildistamiskohad, kus cosplayerid ja sisuloojad on oodatud. Enamikku kohti kasutavad cosplayerid juba praegu. Igal kohal on teema ja fotod, mis võivad sinu tegelasega sobida.
Home.communityDesc: Regulaarsed kokkusaamised, töötoad ja raamatukoguklubid, millega liituda. See on suurepärane viis kohtuda teiste cosplayeritega, jagada nippe ja saada abi oma cosplay plaaniga. Mõned kokkusaamised toimuvad iga nädal, mõned iga kuu ja mõned on ühekordsed.

About.title: <grad>Nulleelarvega</grad> cosplay-kaart Helsingi piirkonnale.
About.intro: Kaart näitab Helsingis, Vantaas ja Espoos kahte asja: animeüritusi ning cosplay-sõbralikke kohvikuid, restorane, kaubanduskeskusi ja pildistamiskohti, kus kostüümis inimesed on oodatud - igaühel pildid ja teema. See kasutab Helsingi linna avatud ruumiandmeid ja ürituste nimekirju, kuvab need kiirel vektorkaardil ning seob kõik kalendri ja ürituste nimekirjaga - kõik 0 EUR/kuus.
About.story1: When I first moved to Europe, I didn't know anyone. I didn't know where to look for cosplay events, and when I did find one, it felt overcrowded and lonely without friends to go with.
About.story2: I have been cosplaying for 15 years. Back in my home country, we used <propsops>Props&Ops</propsops> to follow cosplay events and plan our day around them. Here, as far as I could see, nothing like it existed yet. The event lists I did find only covered one country.
About.story3: Over the years, I found a group of friends and learned a lot from them. Together we have been to events around the Nordic and Baltic countries, and I wanted one place to see all of them, so my friends and I could plan where to go next.
About.story4: That is how CosOverHere started: one map and calendar for cosplay events, cosplay-friendly spots and practice places across the Nordic and Baltic region. I hope it helps other cosplayers too, especially those who are new here and still looking for their people.
About.pastText: A newcomer in Europe with no friends and no idea where the cosplay events were.
About.presentText: One map and calendar for cosplay events, spots and practice places across the Nordic and Baltic countries.
About.futureText: More countries, more community meetups, and more cosplayers finding their friends here.
About.tagline: Find your event. Find your people.
About.nameText: I wanted the name to mix cosplay and map. The Nordic and Baltic countries have the aurora, so cosplay + aurora became Cosora, and map became Atlas. CosoraAtlas was the first name, but it was long and hard to remember. So I made it shorter: cosplay + cover became CosOver, and adding Here gave us CosOverHere.
About.terms1: Images, information, articles and other content on CosOverHere may not be used to pass them off as your own, for commercial purposes, or in any way that causes harm. You may use them if you ask for permission first, or if you credit CosOverHere as the source.
About.terms2: Event information on CosOverHere comes from two kinds of sources. Some events are imported automatically from public open data shared by cities, countries and other websites. Others are added by the CosOverHere team or submitted by visitors. We check listings before they go live, but dates, prices and other details can change or contain mistakes. Always confirm with the official organizer before you go. Each event's data and images belong to their original source, and listings from open data follow that source's license (see Credits below).
About.terms3: CosOverHere celebrates cosplay and art made by real people. We do not accept or feature cosplay photos or artwork that are fully generated by AI, and we remove such submissions. Behind the scenes, we use AI tools only for technical work, such as help with coding and collecting and organizing event data, so we can keep the site free and up to date. Every costume, prop, photo and artwork shown here belongs to the person who made it.
About.creditsLead: Osa selle saidi sisust on teiste tehtud ja jagatud avatud litsentsidega. Aitäh!
About.creditDataUse: Ürituste andmed. Nimekirjad imporditakse automaatselt ja meeskond kontrollib need enne avaldamist.
About.ctaText: Mine otse interaktiivsele kaardile või sirvi piirkonna cosplay-sõbralikke kohti.

Donate.title: Hoia kaart <grad>kofeiini</grad> peal 💛
Donate.intro: See on tasuta ja reklaamivaba hobiprojekt Soome cosplay-kogukonnale. Kui leidsid selle abil oma järgmise coni või pildistamiskoha, hoiab kohv andmed värsked ja serverid töös!
Donate.buttonNote: Turvaline makse Buy Me a Coffee kaudu · kontot pole vaja
Donate.whyText: 100% annetustest läheb otse projekti ülalpidamisse — palku siin ei maksta, on lihtsalt keegi, kes armastab cosplay'd ja avatud kaarte.
